objective: Run A40's frozen test, pre-registered in 510ff23fc before it ran: on the roster of contract.json (square, triangular and honeycomb tori, the genus-2 networks of GL(2,3), the genus-3 networks of PSL(2,7), the Platonic networks; contacts 2, 3 and 4 cells apart; routes of 1 to 10 contacts, every contact off the route frozen), read at the cell level whether the far contact first needs the near ring at lag g L + 1, whether first lags add when routes are joined, and whether with unequal corners the lag is 1 plus the cells along the route; set A40 Confirmed, Overturned or reworded by the frozen rule.
status: Supported 2026-11-08 (exploratory, exact; the frozen test of A40, pre-registered in 510ff23fc before it ran): on 17 networks (square, triangular and honeycomb tori, the genus-2 networks of GL(2,3), the genus-3 networks of PSL(2,7), the Platonic networks) at spacings 2, 3 and 4, all 2,250 isolated routes of 1 to 10 contacts make the far contact first need the near ring at lag g L + 1, all 7,285 splits add, and all 372 routes at unequal spacing give 1 plus the cells carried. A40 Confirmed by its frozen rule.
title: Counted length along isolated routes (the frozen test of A40)
